entries.summary: 按 FR 2026-15181（91 FR 47318）§1(a)，全球 301 计划于 2026-07-24 生效（在途货宽限至 7/28）：17 个经济体 10% 平档（加拿大、墨西哥、印度、印尼、马来西亚、英国等）；EU/台湾 MFN+301 合计封顶 10%，日韩瑞士封顶 12.5%；其余 38 个被调查经济体（含中国、越南、泰国、新加坡、巴西、香港）12.5% 平档；232 覆盖品、USMCA 合规货与 Annex I/II 豁免品免征。该层存在未决诉讼，最终以海关执行为准。
entries.summaryEn: Per FR 2026-15181 (91 FR 47318) §1(a), the global Section 301 program takes effect 2026-07-24 (in-transit grace to 7/28): a flat 10% tier for 17 economies (incl. Canada, Mexico, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, UK); combined MFN+301 caps of 10% (EU/TW) and 12.5% (JP/KR/CH); a flat 12.5% tier for the other 38 investigated economies (incl. China, Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, Brazil, Hong Kong). Section 232-covered goods, USMCA-qualifying goods and Annex I/II exemptions are exempt. Litigation pending — CBP enforcement prevails.

entries.summaryEn: Implementing Section 3 of E.O. 14411 ('Strengthening Customs Enforcement', June 3, 2026), CBP issues an advance notice of proposed rulemaking (19 CFR parts 141/142/143/163, docket USCBP-2026-1058) seeking comments on: (1) submitting foreign export documentation at entry (export declarations, commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, export licenses, transport documents) to detect dual invoicing and undervaluation; (2) stronger manufacturer/shipper/exporter identification (redefining or replacing the MID, expanding the Global Business Identifier test); (3) supply-chain tracing technologies and expanded CTPAT security requirements. Comment stage only — no duty rates or filing obligations are imposed yet; no specific values are given, see the FR text. A follow-up NPRM is planned; potentially applicable to all HTS codes.

entries.title: USITC 就 Section 338(g) 履职方式公开征求意见（截止 2026-11-09）
entries.titleEn: USITC requests comments on implementing Section 338(g) (comments due 2026-11-09)
entries.summary: 依 Tariff Act 1930 §338(g)，USITC 负有持续查明他国对美商业歧视（§338(a)/(b)/(e)）并向总统提供信息与建议的法定职责。委员会现就如何更好履行该职责公开征求意见（91 FR 57387，截止 2026-11-09）。程序性征求意见，不直接调整税率，但 §338 是当前对加拿大汽车/乳制品/酒类加征 50% 附加税的法律基础，且 §338 还授权总统可对维持歧视的国家实施进口禁止，此次履职评估值得跟踪；原文未给出具体数值，详见 FR 原文。
entries.summaryEn: Under Section 338(g) of the Tariff Act of 1930, the USITC must continuously ascertain discriminations against U.S. commerce under Section 338(a), (b) and (e) and advise the President. The Commission invites comments on how best to meet this statutory duty (91 FR 57387; comments due November 9, 2026). Procedural comment request with no direct duty change — but Section 338 is the legal basis of the current 50% additional duties on Canadian motor vehicles/dairy/alcoholic beverages and also authorizes import exclusion, so this implementation review is worth tracking; no specific values are given, see the FR text.

entries.affectedHtsEn: No direct HTS codes (potential Section 338 scope subject to future actions)

entries.summary: 联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）就改革《银行合并法》（BMA）项下并购交易受理与评估程序的拟案公开征求意见（91 FR 60196；RIN 3064-AG18；拟修订 12 CFR 303/314/333），征求意见截止 2026-11-23。要点：竞争效应初评纳入信用社与集中记账存款；对「极小型并购交易」（de minimis merger transactions）设立函件申报与「视为批准」机制；按交易规模与风险画像分级压缩申报负担与处理时限；限定 FDIC 将申报移出加速处理的裁量并成文化法定因素评估。属银行监管领域，与美国进口关税计算无关，不影响任何税目税率。
entries.summaryEn: The FDIC invites comment on a proposed rule (91 FR 60196; RIN 3064-AG18; amending 12 CFR parts 303, 314, and 333) that would reform how it processes and evaluates merger transactions under the Bank Merger Act; comments are due November 23, 2026. Key points: accounting for credit unions and centrally booked deposits in the initial competitive-effects analysis; a letter-filing process with "deemed approval" for de minimis merger transactions; tailoring filing burdens and processing times to a transaction's size and risk profile; and limiting FDIC discretion to remove filings from expedited processing while codifying its statutory-factor evaluation. Bank-regulation matter unrelated to U.S. import duty calculation — no HTS code or duty rate affected.

entries.summary: 商务部产业安全局（BIS）发布 Proclamation 11020（2026-04-02 药品 232 公告，对部分专利药及关联成分征 100% 从价关税，2026-09-29 起对附件 III 以外所有公司生效）的实施指导（91 FR 60360）：(1) 界定 clause 3(d) 项下可获 0% 从价税率的特殊药品类别——孤儿药、核医学、血浆衍生疗法、生育药、细胞治疗产品、基因治疗产品、抗体药物偶联物（ADC）、CBRN 医疗对策及动物健康产品；(2) 列出 19 个合格法域（欧盟、英国、日本、韩国、瑞士和列支敦士登、台湾、印度、印尼、越南、泰国、马来西亚等），名单可在后续公告调整；(3) 规定「紧急美国健康需求」逐案审批程序（pharma232@bis.doc.gov，须报 10 位 HTSUS 分类，随到随审，仅限 Annex I 税号项下的专利药）；(4) HTSUS 技术修正：新增 9903.04.70（仅用于临床试验、研发或其他非商业用途的药品及关联成分，原适用税率 + 0%）、U.S. note 40 (a) 范围改为 9903.04.60-9903.04.70、替换 Annex I (c) 清单 149 个税号（同步纳入 2026-07-01 HTSUS 统计调整）、澄清 pharmaceutical articles/generic pharmaceutical articles 定义（后者纳入未专利动物健康产品）、Annex IV 更新 521 个税号并删除与 Annex I 重叠的 5 个码。修正自 2026-09-29 12:01 a.m. ET 起对入境消费或出仓消费货物生效。

entries.summary: 美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）公告 2027 财年（2026-10-01 至 2027-09-30）进口原糖关税配额（TRQ）配额内数量分配（91 FR 60487）：FY2027 原糖 TRQ 配额内总量 1,117,195 公吨粗值（MTRV，为 WTO 协定下美国承诺的最低量）；其中 1,061,202 MTRV 已于 2026-07-24 完成分配（91 FR 46822），本次将剩余 55,993 MTRV 追加分配至 28 个供应国/地区（多米尼加 11,931、菲律宾 9,151、澳大利亚 5,626、危地马拉 3,254、阿根廷 2,915、秘鲁 2,779 等）。配额内数量自 2026-10-01 起可入境；获分配国家的进口须随附配额资格证明，对糖净进口国的分配以原产地核查合格为条件。依据 HTSUS 第 17 章附加美国注释 5（Additional U.S. Note 5 to Chapter 17）；本次分配调整的是配额准入数量，不改变配额内/外税率水平。
entries.summaryEn: The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) announced the Fiscal Year 2027 (October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027) in-quota quantity allocations of the tariff-rate quota (TRQ) for imported raw cane sugar (91 FR 60487). The FY2027 in-quota quantity is 1,117,195 metric tons raw value (MTRV), the minimum amount committed under the WTO Agreement; 1,061,202 MTRV was allocated on July 24, 2026 (91 FR 46822), and this notice allocates the remaining 55,993 MTRV among 28 supplying countries (Dominican Republic 11,931; Philippines 9,151; Australia 5,626; Guatemala 3,254; Argentina 2,915; Peru 2,779; etc.). In-quota quantities may enter the United States as of October 1, 2026; imports from allocated countries must be accompanied by certificates of quota eligibility, and allocations to net sugar importers are conditioned on verifications of origin. The allocations are made pursuant to Additional U.S. Note 5 to Chapter 17 of the HTSUS; they adjust quota access quantities only and do not change in-quota or over-quota duty rates.

entries.summary: USITC 认定违反 §337 并发出普遍排除令（GEO），禁止侵犯第 8,056,360 号美国专利权利要求 1、4、6、10 的「吸收式制冷系统锅炉保护装置及其部件」进口，同时对 7 家缺席被申请人（均为中国企业）发出停止令（CDO），调查终止（91 FR 60640）。GEO 为普遍性排除令，不区分是否为被申请人——任何主体的涉案侵权产品入境均在禁止之列，进口商需自证产品不落入专利权利要求范围方可放行。属知识产权类进口救济令：禁止的是涉案侵权产品进口，不改变任何关税税率；向美国出口汽车制冷/冷却系统养护用品（如防冻液补充剂类产品）的企业需评估产品是否落入涉案专利范围。原文未给出具体数值，详见 FR 原文。
entries.summaryEn: The USITC has found a Section 337 violation and issued a general exclusion order (GEO) prohibiting the importation of certain boiler protection for absorption refrigeration systems and components thereof that infringe claims 1, 4, 6 and 10 of U.S. Patent No. 8,056,360, along with cease-and-desist orders against seven defaulting respondents, all Chinese companies; the investigation is terminated (91 FR 60640). A GEO applies regardless of who imports the products — entry of any infringing articles within the scope is barred, and importers must show their goods fall outside the patent claims to secure release. entries.summary: CBP 依《文书工作削减法》（PRA）向 OMB 提交全新信息收集申请（OMB 1651-0NEW，91 FR 62738）并开放 30 天意见征询（截止 2026-11-02；此前 2026-05-07 已作 60 天公示，91 FR 24898）：客户代表技术协助门户 CR-TAP 供贸易方通过 ACE Portal 或 clientservicesportal.cbp.gov 向 CBP 报告并跟踪影响 ABI/ACE 电子报关交易的技术问题，CBP 估算年回应约 54,000 次（18,000 名回应人×3 次）、年负担 4,500 小时。属文书负担公示，不改变任何税率或申报要求。
entries.summaryEn: Under the Paperwork Reduction Act, CBP submits a new information collection to OMB (OMB 1651-0NEW, 91 FR 62738) with a 30-day comment window closing 2026-11-02 (after a 60-day notice at 91 FR 24898 on 2026-05-07): the Client Representative Technical Assistance Portal (CR-TAP) lets the trade community report, track and resolve technical issues affecting ABI/ACE electronic cargo transactions via the ACE Portal or clientservicesportal.cbp.gov; CBP estimates ~54,000 annual responses (18,000 respondents x 3) and 4,500 annual burden hours. Paperwork-burden notice only — no duty-rate or filing-requirement change.

entries.title: CBP 信息收集延期公示：IEEPA 法院命令退款 Worksheet（程序性）
entries.titleEn: CBP information collection extension notice: Court-Ordered Refunds under the IEEPA Worksheet (procedural)
entries.summary: CBP 依《文书工作削减法》（PRA）向 OMB 提交既有信息收集的延期复审（OMB 1651-0149「Court-Ordered Refunds under the IEEPA Worksheet」，91 FR 63299）并开放 30 天意见征询（截止 2026-11-04；此前 2026-07-08 已作 60 天公示，91 FR 42207）。背景：2026-02-20 最高法院 Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump 判定 2025-02-03 以来依 IEEPA 征收的全部关税违法，CIT 在 Atmus Filtration 案命令 CBP 对未结案报关单不按 IEEPA 税款清算/重新清算，CBP 正开发自动退款工具处理退款量。负担估算：退款 Worksheet 约 330,000 名回应人、年 495,000 次、495,000 小时；CSV 文件替换项约 33,000 人、16,500 小时。属文书负担公示（程序性），不改变任何关税税率，退款资格与流程仍以法院命令及 CBP 后续指引为准，原文未给出退款金额数值。
entries.summaryEn: Under the Paperwork Reduction Act, CBP submits an extension review of an existing collection to OMB (OMB 1651-0149, 'Court-Ordered Refunds under the IEEPA Worksheet', 91 FR 63299) with a 30-day comment window closing 2026-11-04 (after a 60-day notice at 91 FR 42207 on 2026-07-08). Background: on 2026-02-20 the Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump held all IEEPA tariffs collected since 2025-02-03 unlawful; the CIT's Atmus Filtration orders direct CBP to liquidate/reliquidate unliquidated entries without IEEPA duties, and CBP is building an automated refund tool for the unprecedented refund volume. Burden estimates: refund worksheet ~330,000 respondents, 495,000 annual responses, 495,000 hours; CSV file replacement ~33,000 respondents, 16,500 hours. Paperwork-burden notice only (procedural) — no duty-rate change; refund eligibility and process remain governed by court orders and follow-on CBP guidance; the notice states no refund amounts.

entries.title: 对华 301 产品排除顺应性修正：U.S. note 20(vvv)(i)(20) 排除自 2026-07-01 起改按统计税号 8479.90.9591 描述（维持既有排除覆盖，不改税率）
entries.titleEn: Conforming amendment to a China Section 301 product exclusion: U.S. note 20(vvv)(i)(20) described under statistical reporting number 8479.90.9591 from July 1, 2026 (coverage maintained, no rate change)
entries.summary: 因美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）自 2026-07-01 起实施 HTS 十位统计上报口径调整（依 19 U.S.C. 1484(f)），对华 301 调查产品排除中有 5 项受影响；其中 4 项已由 USTR 于 2026-09-02 修正（91 FR 56538），本通知（91 FR 64211）完成最后一项顺应性修正：修改 HTS 第 99 章第三分章美国注释 20(vvv)(i)(20)，在「January 27, 2022」后插入「through June 30, 2026; described in statistical reporting number 8479.90.9591 effective July 1, 2026」——即该排除项下产品自 2026-07-01 起改按新统计税号 8479.90.9591 描述。此系为维持既有产品排除覆盖范围的技术性修正，排除继续免征对应 301 加征关税，不新增或提高任何税率；追溯适用于 2026-07-01 美东时间 0:01 起进境或出仓供消费的货物，CBP 将另行发布入境与执行指引。
entries.summaryEn: Following the USITC's July 1, 2026 changes to ten-digit HTSUS statistical reporting categories (under 19 U.S.C. 1484(f)), five China Section 301 product exclusions were affected; four were corrected by USTR on September 2, 2026 (91 FR 56538). This notice (91 FR 64211) makes the final conforming amendment: U.S. note 20(vvv)(i)(20) to subchapter III of chapter 99 is modified by inserting "through June 30, 2026; described in statistical reporting number 8479.90.9591 effective July 1, 2026" after "January 27, 2022" — i.e., from July 1, 2026 the covered product is described under the new statistical reporting number 8479.90.9591. This is a technical amendment to maintain the pre-existing exclusion coverage: the exclusion continues to bar the additional Section 301 duties, and no rate is added or raised. Retroactive to goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. EST July 1, 2026; CBP will issue entry guidance.

entries.title: ITC 337 立案调查：特定移动电子设备及其组件（337-TA-1525，trinamiX 诉 Apple）（程序性）
entries.titleEn: ITC institution of Section 337 investigation: certain mobile electronic devices and components thereof (337-TA-1525, trinamiX v. Apple) (procedural)
entries.summary: 美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）公告（91 FR 64398）：应 trinamiX Sensing LLC（Austin, TX）与 trinamiX GmbH（德国）2026-09-03 提交、2026-09-17 补充的申诉，委员会已于 2026-10-05 决定对特定移动电子设备及其组件立案 337 调查（编号 337-TA-1525）——涉案产品范围为 iPhone、iPad 及其处理器与 TrueDepth 摄像头等组件（具备人脸认证、3D 传感和/或材料检测功能的 VCSEL、泛光照明 VCSEL、近红外摄像头模组），被申诉人为 Apple Inc.，涉及 6 项专利（'925、'421、'334、'760、'394、'352），申诉方请求最终发布有限排除令与停止令。本公告系 337 立案程序性公示，立案本身不改变任何关税税率；后续若裁定违反 337 条款可能产生排除令效果，本站将持续跟踪。
entries.summaryEn: The U.S. International Trade Commission (91 FR 64398) gives notice that, on a complaint filed September 3, 2026 and supplemented September 17, 2026 by trinamiX Sensing LLC (Austin, TX) and trinamiX GmbH (Germany), the Commission instituted on October 5, 2026 a Section 337 investigation (No. 337-TA-1525) concerning certain mobile electronic devices and components thereof — the accused products are iPhones and iPads and components such as processors and TrueDepth camera modules (VCSEL, flood-illumination VCSEL, and near-infrared camera components with face authentication, 3D-sensing, and/or material detection capabilities). Respondent: Apple Inc.; six patents alleged ('925, '421, '334, '760, '394, '352). Complainants request a limited exclusion order and cease-and-desist orders. Institution itself changes no tariff rates; an exclusion order could result if a violation is ultimately found.

entries.title: CBP《低值货物》规则拟案：重构 ≤$2,500 简易申报（ET11）并新设邮路电子简易申报（ET13）（征求意见至 2026-12-07）
entries.titleEn: CBP NPRM "Low-Value Shipments": overhaul of informal entry (≤$2,500, ET11) and new electronic informal mail entry (ET13) (comments due December 7, 2026)
entries.summary: 美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）发布规则拟案（91 FR 64532，docket USCBP-2026-0298），在低值免税（de minimis）豁免已中止的背景下重构低值货物通关制度，修订 19 CFR 第 113/128/141/143/145 部分：① informal entry（ET11）申报期限拟由到港后 15 天收紧为「进境当日或之前」，并新增「最终交付方」数据元；② 拟删除 HTSUS 第 99 章第三/四分章货物（如 232/301 措施货物）$250 的简易申报资格上限——$251–$2,500 的相关货物拟不再禁止简易申报；③ 邮路 ≤$2,500 货物拟强制经新设的电子简易申报 ET13 申报（新增申报人/承运人数据元），未在进境后 15 天内申报的邮包拟视为自愿弃货（由 USPS 按其规程处理，可能销毁或退回寄件人）；④ 拟要求所有 ET11/ET13 申报人取得基本进口与入境保证金（bond），并对其违约金设 $1,000 下限。系拟议规则，征求意见截止 2026-12-07，尚未生效，不改变任何关税税率；条文细节详见 FR 原文。
entries.summaryEn: CBP published a notice of proposed rulemaking (91 FR 64532; docket USCBP-2026-0298) to rework low-value shipment processing following the suspension of the de minimis exemption, amending 19 CFR parts 113, 128, 141, 143, and 145: (1) the informal entry (ET11) deadline would tighten from 15 days after arrival to on or prior to the date of importation, with a new final deliver-to party data element; (2) the $250 informal-entry eligibility cap for HTSUS Chapter 99 Subchapters III/IV goods (e.g., Section 232/301 goods) would be removed, so goods of $251–$2,500 would no longer be barred from informal entry; (3) mail shipments of $2,500 or less would be required to file via a new electronic informal mail entry type 13 (new data elements for filers and carriers), and mail articles not entered within 15 days of importation would be deemed voluntarily abandoned (processed per USPS procedures, possibly destroyed or returned); (4) all ET11/ET13 filers would need a basic importation and entry bond, with a $1,000 floor on liquidated damages. Proposed rule only — comments due December 7, 2026; not yet in effect and no tariff rates are changed.
entries.affectedHts: 不针对特定 HTS 税目——适用于申报价值 ≤$2,500 的低值货物（含第 99 章第三/四分章临时贸易措施货物：$251–$2,500 段拟放开简易申报）；法规修订范围为 19 CFR 113/128/141/143/145
entries.affectedHtsEn: Not tied to specific HTS lines — applies to low-value shipments valued at $2,500 or less (including Chapter 99 Subchapters III/IV goods, where informal entry would be opened for the $251–$2,500 range); amends 19 CFR parts 113, 128, 141, 143, 145
